aspect: A card that is geography, not status
description: It allows short stays within a limited distance of the border. Step beyond the zone or the day count and the lawful visit becomes a violation retroactively.
energy_note: Lawful here, unlawful thirty miles further on.

aspect: It is revocable at the bridge, without a hearing
description: An officer at the port of entry can cancel it on suspicion of work or intent to remain. There is no appeal; the card is simply cut or kept.
energy_note: Cancelled by one officer, in one minute.

aspect: Losing it costs the family income
description: For border households the card is the commute - to a shift, a market, a clinic. Cancellation is the loss of a job, not a trip.
energy_note: Not a holiday cancelled. A wage.

description: He has crossed on the card four hundred times for the market. Today his cousin asks him to drop a toolbox in Tucson - seventy miles. He says no. His cousin does not understand why, and he cannot explain that the card is a radius rather than a permission.
energy_note: A permission shaped like a circle on a map.
